Name: WorkspaceSnapshot
Desc: Snapshot a macOS Space's window state to clipboard and restore it later into a fresh space.

items.Name: bindHotkeys
items.Desc: Bind snapshot, snapshotClose, and restore hotkeys.

Parameters.Name: mapping
Parameters.Desc: Table with snapshot/snapshotClose/restore keys, each {mods, key}.

items.Name: start
items.Desc: Start the Spoon (currently a no-op; hotkeys handle the work).
